OTTOMOD-OTTO_CAN.title: Can
OTTOMOD-OTTO_CAN.description: Manually play from either end of your hand to draw 1 card after resolution. Auto-plays do not trigger Can.
OTTOMOD-OTTO_HAND.title: Hand
OTTOMOD-OTTO_HAND.description: The two differently named Hands activate each other for this turn. Identically named Hands do not.
OTTOMOD-OTTO_DELAYED.title: Delayed
OTTOMOD-OTTO_DELAYED.description: Cannot be played until the start of your next turn.
